verdict.rationale: Pilot's evidence pack covers bookkeeping, AP, CFO services, R&D tax credits, and integrations, but there is no mention of creating/sending invoices, online payment collection, or tracking invoice views/payment status — this is an invoicing/AR feature set Pilot does not appear to offer directly (it mentions 'full accounts receivable' generically but no invoicing/payment tooling). missing for 10: invoice creation/sending workflow, online payment collection, read/paid status tracking, any evidence of an AR invoicing product feature.
